newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to hit resistance from 4,310-4,330.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to hit resistance from 4,310-4,330.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will be restored above the 4,300 level on Wednesday and will hit resistance between 4,310-4,330, technical analysts said.

Through a combination of short-covering, mark-ups and some genuine buying interest, the index should push ahead today and a more searching examination of whether the market should be at these levels may be left for a later date, they added.
Wall Street's sparkling performance on Tuesday will assist the FTSE to stretch higher but cohesion among the various sectors is not strong enough to allow it to run away.
By 0724 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 14.2 at 4,301.0
On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 135.26 to 6,587.16 -- its second biggest one day gain ever.

But from its dynamics so far this week analysts expect the FTSE to progress at a more leisurely pace today. Short-term momentum readings for the FTSE indicate the market is now close to being overbought -- and it definitely will be if it goes above 4,340 very quickly.

In contrast, the Dow is merely unwinding from a very oversold state and Tuesday's action now makes it technically neutral short-term. It has the potential to add a further 100-150 points before it becomes overbought, but the pace will slow down.
But since yesterday's blistering pace is not likely to be maintained by the Dow, the FTSE may find itself consolidating for a brief period, analysts said.
